national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: A bust of Marianne, the national personification of France, shown in profile facing left. She is fully clothed in a draped garment.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She wears a Phrygian cap (liberty cap) on her head, which is a classic symbol of freedom and the Republic.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: Liberty is depicted standing rigidly between two gate posts, looking over her left shoulder. In the Type 2 design, her right breast is covered by chainmail armor.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She holds a shield in her left hand and an olive branch in her right hand, representing a state of prepared peace.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: A bust of Germania, the personification of the German nation, shown in profile facing right. She is depicted as a strong, mature woman.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She wears a wreath made of oak and laurel leaves on her head, representing strength and victory.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: A female allegory of Belgium is depicted in a seated posture, leaning comfortably on a lion, which represents the Belgian nation.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She holds a tablet or book inscribed with 'CONSTITUTION BELGE' in one hand. In the background, the Column of Congress and the Brussels Courthouse are visible.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: The effigy of the Republic is shown as a female bust in profile, facing left. She is fully clothed.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She wears a Phrygian cap, a traditional symbol of the republican movement in Brazil.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: A profile view of Marianne facing left. This design by Pierre Gandon shows her with a determined expression, representing the liberation of France.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She wears the Phrygian cap, a staple attribute of the French Republic.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: Britannia is shown in a seated posture, facing right. She is fully clothed in classical robes.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She wears a Corinthian helmet and holds a trident in her right hand and a shield decorated with the Union Flag in her left hand. A lion rests at her feet.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: Britannia is depicted standing on the deck of a ship, moving forward. She is fully clothed in flowing robes that suggest motion.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She holds a trident in her right hand and a shield in her left. A merchant ship is visible in the background.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: Columbia, the early female personification of the USA, is standing and clasping the hand of an American Indian. She is fully clothed in a classic robe.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She is associated with a bust of Washington and symbols of peace.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: The figure of Justice (often synonymous with Columbia in state contexts) stands between the old South Carolina State House and the new Capitol.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She holds the scales of justice in one hand and a sword in the other.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: Germania is depicted standing and facing left. She is fully armored in a breastplate and classical robes.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She holds a sword in one hand and a shield in the other, symbolizing the defense of the nation.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: Germania is shown seated on a throne, turned left. She is fully clothed in noble attire.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She is surrounded by symbols of German industry and trade.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: Marianne is depicted with a profile head but with prominent wings behind her, symbolizing the flight of freedom.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She wears the Phrygian cap. The wings are her most distinctive attribute in this 'London issue'.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: A female head representing the Republic in profile facing left. She is depicted with a serene expression.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She wears a laurel wreath and a Phrygian cap.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: On the reverse, a female allegory of Belgium is seated, leaning on a lion. She is fully clothed in classical drapery.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She holds a tablet of the Belgian Constitution.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: An allegory of Belgium stands rigidly, representing the foundation of the state. She is fully clothed in a gown.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She holds a scepter and the document of the constitution.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: Britannia is seated on a rock, facing right. She is fully clothed in classical robes with a helmet.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She holds a trident in her right hand and a shield in her left. A lighthouse and a ship are visible in the background.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: A stylized profile of Marianne looking left. Her hair is flowing, giving a sense of movement. She is shown from the shoulders up.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She wears the Phrygian cap, which is integrated into the modern, artistic design.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: A profile bust of the female effigy of the Republic facing left. She is fully clothed.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She wears a Phrygian cap and a laurel wreath.

national_allegory_items.visual_description_body_posture: Liberty is shown moving towards the left, walking toward the sun. She is draped in the American flag which flows around her body.
national_allegory_items.visual_description_attributes: She carries a bundle of oak and olive branches in her left arm and extends her right hand as if in a gesture of welcome.
